home.title: Physiotherapy in the Plateau-Mont-Royal
home.intro: Assessment, treatment, and sports or post-surgery rehabilitation with a team of six physiotherapists.
home.hoursText: Choose your service, your physiotherapist and a time that suits you.

availability.title: Availability
availability.noSlots: No availability this week. Try another week or another physiotherapist.
availability.rescheduling: Choose the new time for your appointment.

status.error: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

footer.fictional: Student project: fictional clinic and data.

account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes. Also check your spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.rules: At least 12 characters, without your email address. A phrase of several words is easy to remember.
reset.tooShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.weak: The password must not contain your email address.
reset.invalid: This link is no longer valid (it was already used or it has expired).
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now log in. For your security, all your open sessions were closed.

verify.title: Email address confirmation
verify.done: Your email address is confirmed. You can now log in.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

login.title: Log in
login.unverified: First confirm your email address with the link you received.
login.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.invalidCode: Incorrect code. Try again with the code shown now.
login.mfaSetup: First staff login: set up two-step verification in the desktop app first.

register.title: Create an account
register.intro: We only ask for what is needed for your appointments.
register.comms: I agree to receive electronic communications (optional).
register.sent: Account created. Open the link we emailed you to confirm your address, then log in.
register.invalid: Check the fields: some information is not valid.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.rule: Free cancellation more than 24 hours before: the deposit is refunded. Less than 24 hours before, it is kept.
book.heldUntil: This time is reserved for you until {{time}}.
book.testCard: Test mode: use the card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future date and any code.
book.taken: This time was just taken. Please choose another one.
book.evaluation: A first treatment needs an initial evaluation. Please book an evaluation first.
book.late: Less than 24 hours before the appointment, it can no longer be changed online. Please call the clinic.
book.paymentsOff: Online payment is not available right now. Please call the clinic.
book.missing: No time selected. Go back to the availability page.

done.confirmed: Your appointment on {{day}} at {{time}} with {{name}} is confirmed. See you soon!
done.waiting: Thank you! We are waiting for Stripe's confirmation, it takes a few seconds…
done.slow: The confirmation is taking longer than expected. Your appointment will show as confirmed in “My appointments” as soon as it arrives.

mine.title: My appointments
mine.confirmRefund: Cancel this appointment? It is more than 24 hours before: your deposit will be refunded.
mine.confirmFee: Cancel this appointment? It is less than 24 hours before: the deposit will be kept as a fee.
mine.cancelledRefund: Appointment cancelled. Your deposit will be refunded to your card.
mine.cannotCancel: This appointment can no longer be cancelled online. Please call the clinic.
mine.refundFailed: The refund could not be made right now, so nothing was cancelled. Please try again in a few minutes.
mine.lateHint: Less than 24 hours before: to change it, please call the clinic.
